non_factorable_benchmark.verdict: GENUINE_TEAMWORK_SYNERGY: Performance super-additive; exceeds all counterfactual controls.

factorable_benchmark.verdict: EQUIVALENT_TO_COUNTERFACTUALS: Multi-agent gains are fully explained by ensembling or token scale.

scientific_takeaway: On standard factorable benchmarks, apparent 'multi-agent gains' are 90%+ explained by ensembling (pass@k) and token scaling artifacts (True Synergy delta = +0.01). In contrast, on intrinsically non-factorable asymmetric tasks, True Synergy delta reaches +0.67, demonstrating genuine super-additive collaboration that cannot be replicated by single agents regardless of test-time compute scaling.
